updated_scale_verdict.basis: Deterministic extrapolation of this 100-row calibration mix; not a confidence interval and not valid if the 5,425-row stratum mix differs.
updated_scale_verdict.recommended_wave_composition: Stratified at the calibration mix: approximately 88 competing-lexical, 12 hardest-high-candidate, and 50 from each repeat stratum.
stop_conditions: Any packet/vote integrity, hash, or response-schema failure.
Any label-only match without shared target and discriminating evidence addresses.
Any positional decision whose fingerprint_match_candidates is not a singleton equal to canonical_location.
Any v1-decided conclusion change; preserve side-by-side and pause the affected promotion.
Decided-pair disagreement above 5%, or any repeated disagreement pattern; preserve both reasonings and recalibrate.
Observed gate-qualified yield below 70% in the 250-row wave or lexical-source-lane burden above 30%; recalibrate wave size and routing.
